_comment: Canonical route-level performance budgets. Loaded by scripts/perf-gate.sh and referenced by lighthouserc.json. Budgets are set for simulated 3G on mobile (African market reality). See deploy/references/performance-gate.md for rationale and deploy/references/africa-calibration.md for why these thresholds matter.

/contact/._comment: Forms add modest JS; budget relaxed 10KB not 40KB. No third-party form widgets.

/blog/[slug]/._comment: Longer copy + hero image; still capped under 400KB first-load on 3G.

fail_policy._comment: No tolerance on primary metrics. A 5% warn allows local cache noise without failing CI.
